verdict.rationale: Snyk's core product (scanning engine, vulnerability database, dashboard, prioritization) is a hosted SaaS platform; the evidence only shows a CLI/IDE client and a 'Broker' that lets the SaaS reach into private networks (e.g., self-hosted registries/repos) — it does not self-host the core analysis/platform itself. No documentation describes an on-prem/self-hosted deployment of the core Snyk service.
